title: EventHostPhotosStoragePath
description: Re-encoded host photos at events/{eventId}/hostPhotos/{photoId}/{display.jpg|thumbnail.jpg}, written by addEventHostPhoto without EXIF or location metadata. Checked-in guests and the host team read them only through short-lived signed URLs from listEventHostPhotos.
x-storage-read: server-signed access only; direct client reads denied
x-storage-write: server only; direct client writes denied
